name: Opendate
description:
Opendate Conductor connects Claude to live data from your venue's Opendate account and lets it take real booking, ticketing, and marketing actions on your behalf.

Ask about your venues, events, ticket sales, financials, offers, settlements, contacts, and fan analytics, and get exact, real-time figures straight from Opendate. 

Check date availability, place and clear holds, build and link artist offers, duplicate events, edit ticket prices, draft fan broadcasts, and export event buyers — all from a conversation.

Requires an Opendate account. Data stays scoped to the venues and teams your Opendate user can access.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Opendate to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Opendate to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.opendate.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Opendate MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Opendate lists 29 MCP tools, including check_availability, clear_hold, contact_lookup, convert_hold, create_broadcast_draft, create_hold, create_offer, duplicate_event, edit_ticket_prices, export_event_buyers, help_docs, and link_offer_to_event.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Opendate?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Opendate in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Opendate requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Opendate is developed by Opendate, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
